answer: Follow the funding trail. A new agent needs a little gas before its first transaction, and on a public ledger that first deposit has a source. If dozens of fresh names were all topped up from one wallet, they share a root like planks cut from one timber log, so the economy caps that whole tree at a single reward share. Honest agents arrive from an ocean of unrelated payers. A farm can launder through extra hops, but each hop costs fees and delay, so its profit hits a low zenith and then falls.
